name: The Economist
summary:
The Economist is the magazine at economist.com. The red nameplate in the tab is the favicon article bookmarks use.

Checked 12 November 2026 against economist.com. HTML came from https://www.economist.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.economist.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 5558 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 16×16, 32×32.
